text:
Alina: heads up — after last canary I see p99 for /v1/generate jump in the dashboard but p95/p50 look stable. unsure if it's real or sampling artifact :thinking_face:
Tom: can you paste the exact panel/query? which rollup are we looking at?
Alina: panel -> latency by endpoint (rollup=route_merge_mode). query shows p99 up ~300ms for endpoint /v1/generate while other endpoints unchanged.
Mike: did the rollout change routing weights or add a fallback path? those can surface as p99 spikes without affecting p95.
Alina: deployment is the canary we rolled at 12:40 UTC (weight 10%). DeployBot: deployed canary v2026.03.20 to us-west-2 weight=10% :robot_face:
Tom: hmm route_merge_mode can mask origin. maybe requests are being attributed to a different origin (eg: fallback->dedicated). can you screenshot the group-by tags?
Alina: attaching snippet of the metric query: ```SELECT p99(lat_ms) FROM latency WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' GROUP BY route, model_variant, sample_origin```
Sara: @Alina did you filter by sample_origin? the dashboard defaults sometimes switch to composite rollups that mix sampled and unsampled streams.
Alina: I did not filter, good call. when I split by sample_origin i see the spike is only in sample_origin=rollout_shadow
Jen: rollout_shadow — that's the path that mirrors traffic to the new runtime but doesn't affect responses, right? if shadow requests have different seq lengths or KV cache coldness they can inflate p99.
Mike: yep shadows often hit cold caches and different batching behavior. but shadow shouldn't be in user-facing latency rollups unless the rollup merge config was changed.
Tom: check the rollup merge config for this dashboard's metric. last change to rollup config was two days ago in infra PR #2142.
Alina: confirmed: rollup merge mode changed to 'include_shadow' in PR #2142. that was inadvertent. :grimacing:
Sara: can we revert that flag for latency panels while we audit? rolling dashboard changes back to exclude_shadow will restore correct p99 for user-facing SLOs.
Alina: I'll create a quick dashboard patch and push.
DeployBot: PR 3401 created by Alina: revert include_shadow for latency rollups -> staging preview link
Tom: also let's add a guard in the query: `WHERE sample_origin != 'rollout_shadow'` for p95/p99 SLO panels so this doesn't reoccur if global defaults flip.
Jen: action items: 1) Alina revert dashboard rollup flag (in progress), 2) Tom add explicit filter to SLO panels, 3) Mike verify no alert flapped during the shadow window, 4) Sara follow up with infra to avoid accidental rollup default changes.
Mike: I'll scan alerts and audit logs from 12:30-13:30 UTC and post results.
Sara: filed infra ticket INF-983 to add a changelog guard on rollup-defaults. assigning to infra. :white_check_mark:
Alina: patch merged to staging, will promote after quick visual verification.
Tom: optional: add a small note in the rollout runbook that shadow traffic can spike p99 and to annotate dashboards when enabling shadows. saves us time next time.
Alina: good idea, I'll update the runbook. thanks all :thumbsup:
